verdict.rationale: Anrok's docs describe it as a single hosted tax engine reachable via API/agents (anrok-docs-16, anrok-docs-30), which implies rate/rule logic lives server-side rather than in the customer's code, but the evidence pack never explicitly states that jurisdiction rate/rule changes are pushed automatically, when they take effect, or that no redeploy is ever required. Missing for 10: an explicit changelog or rate-update documentation, an SLA/guarantee of automatic rule updates, and confirmation that no client-side redeploy is ever needed for rate changes.
